adopt: Schedule one voice-channel hangout, let people RSVP, and read back who was reminded and who came.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
A community event lives in three places that never agree: the Discord event, somebody's calendar, and a pinned message. Moving the time in one leaves the others wrong, nobody gets reminded unless they set it up themselves, and afterwards nobody knows who actually showed up.

Install
not yet published; builds in-tree

Commands
  awgather

Quick start
  pip install -e.
  awgather --self-test # the engine against fakes, no network
  export DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN=... # a BOT token with Manage Events
  awgather create --guild G --channel VOICE --title "Community Hangout" \
   --start 2026-11-21T20:00:00Z --end 2026-11-21T22:00:00Z --tz America/Los_Angeles
  awgather list
  awgather sync --guild G # reconcile Discord <-> calendar
  awgather tick # reminders, start, attendance, recap
synopsis: Community events that live in your calendar and your Discord at once.
